llm.summary: The skill's runtime instructions are coherent for managing ERC‑4337 smart accounts, but the package metadata omits the sensitive runtime configuration the SKILL.md requires, creating an unexplained mismatch you should resolve before installing.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name and description match its instructions (creating/funding/managing ERC‑4337 accounts, on‑chain fees and enforcement). However, the published registry metadata claims no required environment variables or credentials, while the SKILL.md explicitly requires RPC access and signer configuration (GUARDRAIL_CHAIN_ID, GUARDRAIL_RPC_URL, GUARDRAIL_SIGNING_MODE and, for external signer, GUARDRAIL_SIGNER_ENDPOINT and GUARDRAIL_SIGNER_AUTH_TOKEN). That discrepancy is unexplained and inconsistent.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md instructions stay within the stated purpose: preparing transactions, reading on‑chain state, and relying on secure signing models. It explicitly forbids requesting private keys in chat and recommends read‑only mode if signing isn't configured. No instructions appear to request unrelated local files or cloud credentials. Still, the skill expects runtime secret storage and external signer interactions — the metadata omission makes it unclear how those secrets will be provided or enforced at install/runtime.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction‑only skill with no install spec and no code files; nothing is written to disk by an installer. That lowers installation risk. The security surface is primarily the runtime execution environment and how signing is integrated.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The environment/credential requests described in SKILL.md (RPC URL, chain ID, signer endpoint and auth token, and optional dashboard API key) are appropriate for an on‑chain signing workflow. However, the registry lists no required env vars — a significant metadata omission. Because signer auth tokens and RPC endpoints are sensitive, the absence of declared required env vars in the registry is an incoherence that should be resolved before trusting or installing the skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request system config paths. Autonomous invocation (model may call the skill) is allowed by default — which is expected — but with signing integrations that could broaden impact. Ensure the signer enforces least privilege/rate limits and that the runtime validates chainId and rejects unsupported networks.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Do not install or run this skill until the metadata discrepancy is resolved and you can verify the signing setup. Specifically: (1) Ask the publisher for source code, homepage, and an explanation why the registry lists no required env vars while SKILL.md demands RPC and signer secrets. (2) If you proceed, keep signing strictly out of chat — use an external signer/HSM or wallet-connector as recommended; never paste private keys. (3) Ensure GUARDRAIL_SIGNER_ENDPOINT uses TLS, authenticates with short‑lived tokens, enforces allowlists/value caps, and logs/grants only the minimal permissions needed. (4) Verify all contract addresses and ABIs on‑chain (and confirm the FeeCollector/GuardrailFeeManager behavior) before sending funds. (5) Start in read‑only mode until a reviewed signing integration is in place. (6) Prefer to see an official homepage, source repository, or third‑party audit before trusting this skill with real assets.
